mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slowdown, indicated by UNRATE rising above 7.0%, signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signals a contraction in household spending, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumption-driven corporate revenue.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 100.5), manufacturing output expansion supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.5, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) consistently signals strong household spending and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 600, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220), as measured by the consumer price index, prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230), the Federal Reserve's aggressive rate hikes lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs suppress corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.04.
